parts.one_line: A research-lab machine-and-implant system that injects programmable microscopic robots into a mob, where they run scriptable programs (healing, buffs, sensors, weapons) powered by a self-replenishing nanite volume and remotely controllable by codes.
player_facing_mechanics: Get nanites injected/removed via nanite chamber or public nanite chamber (auto-inject/eject on close)
Nanites have a saturation volume that regenerates over time and is spent by active programs
Set the nanites' safety threshold (0-500) below which programs stop consuming
Set a cloud ID (0-100) to sync/backup the program set to a nanite cloud controller
Remote-sync nanites to cloud backups: if unsynced they may corrupt (software errors)
Program individual nanite programs on disks (activation/deactivation/kill/trigger codes, restart/shutdown/trigger timers, extra settings)
Download researched nanite program designs from the techweb onto a disk at a nanite program hub
Upload/download/delete programs in a cloud backup; add/remove sensor 'rules' and toggle All-vs-Any rule logic
Install nanite programs into a host via cloud-linked chamber injection
Scanned readout of nanites (saturation, max, safety threshold, cloud id, program list/status) via nanite scanner, body scanner, or the chamber console
Control nanites remotely with a nanite remote (modes: Off, Local/Self, Targeted, Area/AOE radius 7, Relay) sending a numeric code
Save/load/delete named remote settings and lock/unlock the remote (ID-locked, emaggable to bypass)
Nanite communication remote sends a text message with the code
Programs have passive effects (armor, traits, regen, purge, heal, mood, mindshield, etc.) and triggerable effects (defib, heartbeat toggle, EMP, explosive, revive)
Nanite program disk boxes: standard, random, and a cybersun/syndicate set with weaponized programs
AI can open a nanite remote menu (innate/ai ranged action) to signal nanites
Anti-nanite (naniteremover) and nanite booster reagents, pills, and bottles manipulate nanite volume
Disease symptoms Nano-symbiosis and Silicolysis interact with nanites (boost or destroy them)
Nanite HUD indicator and diagnostic nanite saturation bar
Mood events for happiness enhancer/suppressor programs
Emag the nanite remote to override its ID lock
Customize a public nanite chamber's cloud ID with a multitool

parts.port_notes: Nanites is a very large, tightly-coupled system: it maps most naturally onto SS14 as a solution-specific ECS feature with a NanitesComponent holding volume/max/regen/threshold/cloud_id and a NaniteProgram data model (programs as prototype-driven datums data plus per-program systems or entity programs), a NaniteSystem driven by an update loop (equivalent to SSnanites), and events replacing the COMSIG_NANITE_* signal set. Machines (chamber, chamber control, cloud controller, program hub, programmer) port as entity prototypes plus UI-bound systems (BoundUserInterface/UI states replace TGUI ui_data/ui_act/static_data), the techweb link maps to the research system's technology DB, DoAfter replaces do_after for injection timers and chamber breakout, and actions map to SS14 actions for the AI/remote menus. Key design questions a human must answer: whether programs are entity prototypes (YAML) with C# effect systems or a custom script/behaviour registry; how to model the remote-code/signal and rules/condition system; how tightly to bind nanites to the medical/physiology stack (armor, traits, body-part healing, reagents, mood) which are themselves not yet fully ported; and whether to keep the SIG-based cloud sync/corruption semantics or redesign them. This is part 1 (further files likely add more program/sensor/rule definitions), so the full surface area is larger than this excerpt.

parts.one_line: Nanites are microscopic programmable machines injected into a mob that run a stack of named 'programs' (healing, sensors, suppression, weapons) which trigger or passively affect the host.
player_facing_mechanics: Rogue/defective programs that decay from other programs and deal passive damage or debuffs: Glitch, Necrosis, Toxin Buildup, Hypoxemia, Neuro-Necrosis, Brain Misfire, Dermalysis, Nerve Decay

Sensor programs send a numeric signal code when a condition is met (health percent, crit, death, nanite volume, damage type/amount, voice/sentence heard, species, alive, assistant job, incapacitated, resting)
Signal Repeater re-sends a signal after a configurable delay; Relay Signal Repeater re-sends a signal on a relay channel; Relay program registers the host as a long-range relay node

Suppression programs: Sleep Induction, Paralysis (escalating use_rate), Electric Shock, Neural Shock/stun, Pacification (TRAIT_PACIFISM), Blindness, Mute, Death Simulation (fake death), Happiness Enhancer/Suppressor (mood events), Alcohol Synthesis (adds ethanol reagent), Weakening Procedure (TRAIT_EASILY_WOUNDED), Gravity field (1G/2G forced gravity element)

Weaponized programs: Cellular Breakdown, Poisoning (vomits), Memory Leak, Aggressive Replication, Meltdown, Chain Detonation (explosion scaling with nanite volume), Heart-Stopper, Electromagnetic Resonance (empulse), Sub-Dermal Combustion (ignites host), Cryogenic Treatment (cools host), Mind Control (brainwash directive for 60s), Neural/Brain Traumatic Nanites (gain/cure traumas), Respiratory Distress (lung organ loss)

Utility programs: Viral Replica (spreads/syncs nanites to nearby mobs), Host Scan (medical/chemical/nanite self-scan), Stealth (hides nanite HUD indicator), Reduced Diagnostics, Metabolic Synthesis (converts nutrition to nanites), Subdermal ID (copies ID access from held/equipped items), Infective Exo-Locomotion (infects nearby humans via component), Nanite Sting (infects adjacent non-host), Mitosis (self-replication with corruption chance), Dermal Button (adds a clickable action button with configurable name/icon/sent code), Simple Bot Construction (spawns a temporary simple bot), Monitoring (suit sensor network integration)

Research techweb nodes unlock nanite designs across tiers (Basic, Smart, Mesh, Biological, Neural, Synaptic, Harmonic, Military, Hazard, Replication/Storage protocols, Tools, Experimental, Advanced Medical)

Extra settings UI values: sent code, delay, comm code, relay channel, health/nanite percent, direction, damage type/amount, message, directive, sentence, inclusive/exclusive, race, mode, mood message, program/cloud overwrite, scan type, button name/icon, tool choice, bot choice
Nanite rules attached to programs (health, crit, death, nanite volume, damage, alive, incapacitated, resting) with a max of 5 rules per program

parts.port_notes: This is the program/content half of nanites: dozens of program datums plus sensor, suppression, utility and weapon behaviours, plus extra-setting and rule helper datums and research node definitions. In SS14 every nanite program would become a prototype (data fields: name, id/descriptor, use rate, rogue/decay targets, trigger cost/cooldown, extra-setting schema) with a corresponding ECS system or component implementing the active/passive/trigger logic; triggers map to events, sensor conditions to event subscriptions, timed effects to timers, mood/traits/status effects to their SS14 equivalents, and techweb nodes to research prototypes. The extra-settings/rules UI metadata would map to a networked UI (BUI) rather than the current get_frontend_list assoc lists. Human design questions: how to model program stacking/decay and the shared nanite-component state (volume, safety threshold, cloud, stealth), whether to represent 'rules' as data-driven entity-system conditions, and how to keep the many per-program effects composable without a combinatorial explosion of systems.
